description: Create a small backend service with a health check endpoint that can be used to verify the application is running.
requirements: Repository should contain a runnable backend project
Application should expose a GET health check endpoint such as /health or /api/health
Health check response should include an HTTP 200 status and a JSON body
Project should include clear local run instructions in README.md
Repository should include at least one sample request using curl, Postman collection or HTTP file
title: Create Health Check API
